Paradigm is a Bedrock-only survival network built around Crownrise, a persistent kingdom realm where you begin with a charter, establish a camp, and grow it into a true capital. Construct resource buildings, recruit residents, send expeditions, command troops, trade through markets, defend your walls, wage kingdom wars, and pursue the Wonder Monuments. Your kingdom physically develops in the world, and your progress is meant to last.

For players who prefer lawless survival, Paradigm Anarchy offers a massive 3-million-block world border with nether-roof building, stackable potions, proximity chat, player-head drops, and no phantom interruptions.

Across Paradigm, enjoy compass waypoints, named Ender Pearl stasis chambers, invisible item frames, expanded Ender Chest storage, shulker previews through /peek, durability and saturation displays, renamed global mobs and death messages, and a public /features guide. Exceptional community builds can also be voted into the Paradigm Museum, preserving the server’s greatest creations and history for everyone to revisit.
